followUpVerification.description: Ran the y=865 repro again and, after the freeze, observed the scene for 8+ more seconds and tried several move-away clicks.
followUpVerification.evidence: Ship energy regenerated normally (16.6 -> 32.6 over ~8s) and Ion Storm continued its trochoid drift (~2164px moved) during the freeze window -- only the Meteoroid (and transiently the ship) stopped.
followUpVerification.shipEscapeEvidence: First two move-away clicks after the freeze produced no ship movement at all; a third, later click succeeded (ship resumed normal velocity).

findings.errorType: Meteoroid Permanently Immobilized After Ship/Boundary Collision
findings.detail: Meteoroid froze at (2302.6, 900) and stayed there for the rest of this 7.3s trial (velocity snapped from (280,0) to exactly (0,0) in one tick). Trigger: the ship's collision edge reached the world's right boundary (ship at x=2377, 23px from the 2400px edge -- its own 23px half-width) in the same physics step it was still grazing the Meteoroid (94.5px apart). Meteoroid stopped 153.4px short of MovingHazardManager's wrap threshold (levelWidth+radius=2456), so it can never self-recover via the normal wrap-and-respawn path.
